program:
move 0,R0
 wait_sync 100
_start: reset_ph 
 upd_param 1000
 set_awg_offs 0,0
 upd_param 4
 move 0,R33
 move 1,R32
 cmp R30,R31
 move 0,R32
 jbe @cmove1
 move 1,R32
cmove1: cmp R30,R31
 move 0,R1
 jbe @cmove2
 move 1,R1
cmove2: cmp R30,R32
 move 0,R2
 jbe @cmove3
 move 1,R2
cmove3: nop 
 and R1,R2,R33
 stop
